title: TypeError: instantSearchInstance.sendEventToInsights is not a function
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

My application started to throw exception:
`TypeError: instantSearchInstance.sendEventToInsights is not a function`

The code is located inside `createSendEventForHits.js`

I even upgraded to version `^4.8.3` but the problem is still happening. (using ` algoliasearch: ^4.5.1` and `vue-instantsearch 3.4.2`)

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

**Steps to reproduce the behavior:**

1. Go to https://www.seek-team.com/en/players?country=FR,BE
2. Click on "Display player's map"
3. The error happens
